verdicts.evidence: A static AST-based audit of the released code found 19 registered tools, 8 skill documents, implementations for all 8 pipeline stages, and a Claude Agent SDK streaming loop with a stepwise tool-use system prompt, but the pipeline was never executed, the ReAct loop is delegated to the SDK rather than locally implemented, and the 'first' priority claim was not evaluated.

No benchmark execution was performed; the logbook states the required model (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) is retired, the 306 original traces and predictions are not released, and the repository lacks an automatic success judge. Source-text concordance checks only confirm the paper contains the numbers, not that they reproduce.

An independent JSONL parser recomputed 102 records with 102 unique IDs and queries, 18 categories, 8 stages, and tier counts exactly matching {basic: 40, intermediate: 28, advanced: 21, challenging: 13}, with schema, duplication, stage-count, and tier-complexity consistency checks all passing.

The released evaluator implements the metric families, but the official dataset lacks CRC-CODEX evaluation inputs, generated quantification outputs, and the complete ground-truth bundle, so the reported Pearson 0.953, Spearman 0.902, and MMD 0.368 could not be recomputed.

Four ground-truth files covering 2,013,525 rows pass structural schema checks, but original agent predictions are absent, so the reported average CyteOnto similarity of 0.681 and per-sample high of 0.765 cannot be recomputed; the logbook also notes an evaluator row-order sensitivity issue.

overall: The logbook independently verifies the SP-Bench benchmark composition (102 queries, 18 categories, 8 stages, correct tier split) and partially confirms the agent architecture via static code audit (19 tools, 8 stages, SDK-based tool-use loop). The three numerical performance claims—execution accuracy, CRC-CODEX quantification metrics, and cell-annotation similarity—remain inconclusive because original model traces, predictions, and evaluation inputs are unavailable.
